diagram_math_checks.justification: For fixed x_0 in V_i, no isolation supplies a neighbor z (Example and proof step 2.2); bipartiteness places z in V_{1-i}. The two dashed boxes label the two sides, and the caption explicitly states that only this selected edge is shown. No additional vertices or degree assumptions are asserted.

The upper arrow is x_0 to z and carries 1/deg(x_0)>0; the lower arrow is z to x_0 and carries 1/deg(z)>0. Both are defined by the displayed simple-random-walk row and undirectedness, with finite positive degrees from Given and step 1.1. Unequal degrees are permitted.

The two arrows form x_0 to z to x_0. Their product is 1/(deg(x_0)deg(z))>0, a single nonnegative summand of p^(2)(x_0,x_0) by F2/step 2.2. Step 2.1 establishes support containment (not equality) in V_i at even times and V_{1-i} at odd times. The prose retains containment and hence odd-time vanishing. F4 and step 3.1 give period two; zero time is not a positive return.

All six original numbered proof steps and all original facts, hypotheses and dependency metadata are byte-preserved. The illustration appears after Source notes in a new Remarks section and supplies no premise to the proof.
